claims.description: A focused behavioral regression proves that a DATABASE_URL-only Neon pooled endpoint resolves to the corresponding direct endpoint. Deliberately restoring the pooled fallback makes this assertion fail, and restoring the fix makes it pass.

The existing teardown closes the scratch pool, polls pg_stat_activity for the generated scratch database until all backends are gone, and then uses a normal DROP DATABASE; this rework does not add FORCE or backend termination.
The replay now avoids the PgBouncer backend retention observed in review by converting only a Neon -pooler hostname when no explicit DIRECT_URL is available.

Explicit DIRECT_URL values retain precedence and disposable local/CI URLs are unchanged, preserving the suite's isolated scratch-database execution path. Real-database replay and cleanup remain required exact-head PR CI evidence.
